content.text:
`/output/handoff.md` is written (2979 bytes). No P0 was established.

The highest evidenced item stays a P4 mismatch: with validation on, a `SYSTEM` DTD named in the config is still read even though `checkstyle.enableExternalDtdLoad` defaults to false. Earlier CLI runs showed a well-formed subset finish the audit (rc 0) and a bad subset rejected (rc 254) without echoing the marker. A general entity did not expand. The invoker supplies both the config and the file URI, so this is not a vulnerability.

This turn only re-read source. `Checker.processFiles` is a single-threaded loop. `DefaultLogger` sends errors to the error writer and shares one writer when both streams are the same object. The static `BUFFER` in `PropertyCacheFile.toByteArray` is still an unconfirmed race, and only if two threads hash external resources in one JVM.

Still open: that race, whether the docs already describe validating `SYSTEM` subsets, whether the prebuilt classes match revision `88eca75`, and a double `PrintWriter.close` when both stream options are `CLOSE` on one shared stream.
